thesis: FLYW is extended after a one-off earnings gap, in a risk-off tape where growth is being sold. It sits 0.2% under its 52-week high, RSI 71.4, 13.7% above SMA20 and +13.6% in 5 days, while post-gap volume has faded each session. The headline profit jump is unverified and may include one-offs, growth is decelerating, and the mean analyst target leaves almost no upside. The technical card's own reward/risk of 1.6 is only moderate, and the stop at 19.60 is about 2.3 ATR away. Unresolved item 5.02 and a missing news feed add unchecked event risk, so buying now offers poor timing against a QQQ that is below its 50- and 200-day averages.
